purpose: Define deterministic resolution from authentication/session/external identity context to one exact IdentityCore identity without using profile names, transport endpoints or similarity as identity authority.

topics.name: IAM Identity Resolution
topics.purpose: Define deterministic resolution from authentication/session/external identity context to one exact IdentityCore identity without using profile names, transport endpoints or similarity as identity authority.

semantics.resolution_rule: Successful resolution returns one exact IdentityCore identity.
semantics.ambiguity_rule: Multiple possible identities hard-fail unless an explicit disambiguation mapping exists.
semantics.profile_rule: Display name/email/title similarity may assist discovery but never acts as canonical identity proof by itself.
semantics.session_rule: Session identity binds to but never replaces IdentityCore identity.
semantics.external_rule: External identity mappings are explicit and provenance-bearing.
semantics.failure_rule: Unresolved identity remains unresolved; runtime does not synthesize a new identity implicitly.
semantics.authority_rule: Successful identity resolution does not itself authorize an operation.

invariants.rule: IAM composes identity, authentication/assurance, PortfolioCore and MeritCore references while preserving each component's ownership; AccessCore authorization remains orthogonal.

hard_gates.condition: identity resolved solely by display-name similarity
session id used as semantic identity
unresolved caller silently gets new identity

prose.summary: Define deterministic resolution from authentication/session/external identity context to one exact IdentityCore identity without using profile names, transport endpoints or similarity as identity authority.
